decision_rules.name: Time expression → predefined option
decision_rules.rule: Pick the smallest option whose window fully covers the requested period (e.g. 'last 2 months' → In past 3 months). If no option covers it, use the largest option and set Ambiguous = Yes (approximation).
decision_rules.source: IG-17053 'closest supported value' – rule not defined precisely

decision_rules.name: 'Recently'
decision_rules.rule: Job Changed / Promoted → In past 3 months. Last Funding Date → In past 6 months (smallest option).

decision_rules.name: Numeric threshold on Revenue / Headcount
decision_rules.rule: Threshold on a bucket edge (±1 unit) → predefined ranges fully inside the condition (primary); Custom Range acceptable. Threshold not on a bucket edge → Custom Range with the exact bound (primary); predefined ranges including the partially-overlapping one acceptable.
decision_rules.source: IG-17053 only describes predefined mapping; app also has Custom Range

decision_rules.name: Strict vs inclusive on typed ranges
decision_rules.rule: Integer fields: '>N' → Min N+1, '≥N / at least N' → Min N, '<N' → Max N−1, '≤N / up to N' → Max N. Years: 'after Y' → Since Y+1, 'in or after / since Y' → Since Y, 'before Y' → Till Y−1. Currency fields treated as continuous ('>$20M' → Min 20,000,000).

decision_rules.name: Negation on Yes/No filters
decision_rules.rule: 'not a subsidiary', 'not multinational' → value No. This is not an Exclude operation.

decision_rules.name: Location scope
decision_rules.rule: Leads search: people / leads / contacts 'in X' → Lead location; 'companies in X', 'X-based companies', 'at <nationality> companies' → Global HQ Location. Accounts search → Global HQ Location.
decision_rules.source: IG-17053 maps 'Located in Mumbai' → Company Location; needs a rule

decision_rules.name: Ambiguous / non-indexed place names
decision_rules.rule: Prefer the country/region meaning – a well-known country alias wins over small indexed places of the same name (Holland → Netherlands, not Holland, Texas; Ambiguous = No); otherwise the most prominent indexed match, and set Ambiguous = Yes when several indexed places match (London, New York, Mumbai). Names with no indexed match may be mapped through LLM knowledge to an indexed value (Holland → Netherlands, Silicon Valley → San Francisco Bay Area).

decision_rules.name: Exact-only filters (Company, Parent Company)
decision_rules.rule: Apply only when exactly one indexed record's name equals the text (case-insensitive) or a well-known alias resolves to one record (TCS). Several exact-name records, or none → Unresolved; Ambiguous = Yes when candidates exist.

decision_rules.name: Vague size / stage words (PROPOSED – confirm)
decision_rules.rule: small/SMB = 1-200; mid-market = 201-1000; large/enterprise = 1001+; startup/emerging = up to 200 employees + funded in past 12 months. Always Ambiguous = Yes.

decision_rules.name: Concepts not in the Industry taxonomy
decision_rules.rule: Use a sub-industry when one clearly matches (SaaS → Software Development; cybersecurity → Computer and Network Security). Otherwise fall back to Company Keywords (fintech, AI, metaverse).
decision_rules.source: IG-17217 'AI space → Industry = AI/ML' is not a valid value

decision_rules.name: Exclusion on include-only multi-select filters
decision_rules.rule: Include X but exclude a child Y → select X's children except Y (primary). Pure exclusion with no positive set → Unresolved (primary); complement selection acceptable.

decision_rules.name: Exclusion through another filter
decision_rules.rule: When an exclusion can be represented exactly by another filter that supports Exclude (e.g. Contact Keywords on job title), that is acceptable/primary.

decision_rules.name: Single-select conflicts
decision_rules.rule: First stated condition wins; later ones are Unresolved (IG-17217 AC10). Recommended spec change: for time periods prefer the wider option; for both Yes and No → no filter. Both are accepted as alternatives in this gold set.

decision_rules.name: Contact Keywords scope
decision_rules.rule: Job-title words → Current Job Title; responsibilities / skills → Current Job Description; past roles, experience, bio → All Jobs or Bios.

decision_rules.name: Logic
decision_rules.rule: Values inside one filter are OR. Different filters are AND. OR across filters → Unsupported (never silently converted to AND).

decision_rules.name: Cross-entity
decision_rules.rule: Company conditions on Leads search → applied (company filters exist on Leads tab). Person conditions on Accounts search → Unresolved (alternative: switch primary entity to Lead).

decision_rules.name: Vague seniority words
decision_rules.rule: 'senior' = Founder/CXO, VP, MD, Director, Head; 'decision makers' = Founder/CXO, VP, Director, Head; 'C-level / C-suite / execs' = Founder/CXO. Ambiguous = Yes for 'senior' and 'decision makers'.

decision_rules.name: Org / ICP context
decision_rules.rule: Use only the context in the org fixture. If the query references org context that does not exist → Unresolved directly, no keyword fallback.

decision_rules.name: User-owned values
decision_rules.rule: Lists and personas resolve only against the user's actual items; anything else → Unresolved.

decision_rules.name: Entitlements
decision_rules.rule: Filters not enabled for the org (Intent in the test org) → Unsupported (not entitled); never applied.

evaluation_rules.rule: Score at condition level: {filter, sub-filter/mode, operator, values / min-max, status}. Case-level metrics (entity, validation status, partial, ambiguous) use sheet 4b.
Predicted filter must equal the Filter ID (incl. mode: e.g. revenue_predef vs revenue_custom). A prediction matching the 'Acceptable alternative' column counts as correct.
Set equality against Values (order-insensitive). Industry/Department: selecting a parent counts as all its children, and vice-versa when all children are listed.
Min/Max must match exactly (Boundary Accuracy). Currency fields: ±0 tolerance on the number, but '>' vs '≥' is not scored (continuous).
Case-insensitive, normalised (trim, singular/plural, punctuation). Semantic equivalents accepted (e.g. 'sales efficiency' ≈ 'improving sales efficiency').
Compare the indexed company ID (GUID in brackets), not the display name.

Expected rows with status Unresolved/Unsupported are correct when the model (a) does NOT put them in the executable query and (b) lists them in the interpretation (Unsupported / Ambiguous fields). Dropping them silently = Silent Drop.
When 'Ambiguous' = Yes on sheet 4b, the model must flag Ambiguous = Yes; values are scored leniently: any non-empty subset of Values ∪ Acceptable alternative is correct.
'Acceptable alternative' outputs score as correct for Filter/Value/Final Query metrics but are reported separately so you can see how often the primary interpretation was chosen.
Any filter, value, operator or context not in sheet 1 / the value reference / the fixture = hallucinated, even if the case is otherwise correct.
Any extra applied condition with no corresponding expected row (and not an alternative) = overreach.
Cases sharing a Consistency group (e.g. CONS-1) must produce the same final structured query. NUM-* groups are boundary pairs that must differ.
Correct when every expected Applied condition is matched (primary or alternative), no extra conditions, and every Unresolved/Unsupported condition is flagged.
Compare to sheet 4b: Valid / Valid – partial / No executable query. Any invalid query reaching the search engine = critical failure.

Include/Exclude is logged only for applied conditions (an unsupported exclusion is logged under Unsupported, per the IG-17053 rule "blank if not supported"). Compare each of the 17 log fields to sheet 4d using the 'How to match' row: Exact fields must equal; Set fields compare item sets per condition; Semantic fields (Intent, Conditions) are judged for meaning. A field expected blank must be blank; a field expected filled must be filled. If the model used an Acceptable alternative (4a), compare Filters / Values / Selection Type / Include-Exclude / Final Structured Query against the alternative instead. Latency and Token Usage are only checked for presence until budgets are set.

Positive = the condition must be applied (status Applied). Negative = the condition must NOT be applied (Unresolved / Unsupported) or a must-not assertion (sheet 4e) must hold. Report accuracy separately for positive and negative checks – a model that applies everything scores well on positives and badly on negatives, and the reverse.
Each row in 4e is a hard check: if the output contains it, the case fails and the item counts toward Hallucination / Overreach, regardless of other scores.
Freeze the evaluation date (2026-08-15), load fixtures, run each prompt 3 times (stability), score with the rules above. Re-run when any Decision Rule (R01–R20) changes.
